summary: Compact servo mounting block with an integrated bearing and a hub-shaft. It is a rectangular machined plate with a raised bearing boss and a round hub on top, a large oval/round servo-spline clearance opening, and threaded mounting holes on the top face and sides. It holds a standard-size servo and isolates radial loads from the servo output.

mountingSurfaces.description: Top face of the channel plate, with the hub-shaft rising 8mm from it and the bearing boss in the center; threaded holes sit in a 16mm square pattern.
Side faces (27mm apart) with threaded holes for M4 screws.
Underside, which seats against the standard-size servo body and is secured with four screws through the servo ears.

notes: Only the 27mm width is stated. Length (~56mm) and overall height are estimated from the proportions in the images and a standard servo footprint. The hole diameters and positions, including the 4mm M4 tap size and the ~16mm spline opening, are approximate. The 16mm square pattern and the 8mm hub-shaft rise come from the specs. The 14mm bearing protrusion diameter is not modeled as a hole. Hole positions are relative to the part center and are not verified.
